basis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

basis.sentenceEn: Rather, we ascribe meanings to texts on the basis of interaction between what we might call textual and contextual material: between kinds of organization or patterning we perceive in a text's formal structures (so especially its language structures) and various kinds of background, social knowledge, belief and attitude that we bring to the text.
basis.translationZh: 相反，我们赋予文本意义是基于我们所谓的文本材料与语境材料之间的互动：一方面是我们在文本形式结构（尤其是语言结构）中感知到的各种组织方式或模式，另一方面是我们带入文本的各种背景知识、社会认知、信念和态度。

broad.sentenceEn: It gains Microsoft broad rights to the data inputted or outputted by any user — rights to use this data in any way it sees fit; it can even share it with third parties.
broad.translationZh: 这使微软获得了用户输入或输出数据的广泛权利——微软有权以其认为合适的任何方式使用这些数据，甚至可以将其与第三方共享。
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

broad.sentenceEn: The Time to Act study also found that while control pupils relied on "desert island clichés" such as palm trees, target pupils were "more expansive [giving] a broader picture of the sky, the sea and the atmospheric conditions".
broad.translationZh: 《及时行动》研究还发现，对照组学生依赖诸如“棕榈树”之类的“荒岛陈词滥调”，而目标组学生则“表达更为丰富，展现出天空、海洋和大气状况的更广阔图景”。
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

broad.sentenceEn: "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
broad.translationZh: 一位受访者表示：“艺术家帮助科学家接触更广泛的受众，并建立情感联系，从而促进学习。”
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

broad.sentenceEn: When the skills mismatch is in the broader economy though, the focus usually turns to government to handle.
broad.translationZh: 然而，当技能不匹配问题存在于更广泛的经济层面时，人们通常会期望政府来解决。
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

broad.sentenceEn: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
broad.translationZh: 法国拟议的这项税收是一个明确的警告：除非各国能就国际税收体系改革达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能会纷纷效仿，而美国企业将面临数十个国家征收的一系列不同税收，这将被证明是既繁重又代价高昂的。
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

broad.sentenceEn: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
broad.translationZh: 这表明，为日益艰巨的工作岗位招募顶尖人才符合更广泛的企业利益。
broad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

being.sentenceEn: It turned from God and the authority of the Roman Catholic Church and instead favoured a more humanistic approach to being .
being.translationZh: 人们的目光从上帝和罗马天主教会的权威转向，转而青睐一种更加人文主义的生存方式。
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

being.sentenceEn: Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings , even when they display only simple social signals.
being.translationZh: 同样地，儿童也倾向于将机器人视为同类，即便这些机器人仅表现出简单的社交信号。
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

being.sentenceEn: This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being , says Quinn.
being.translationZh: 奎因表示，这表明老鼠将社交机器人视为真正的社交生物。
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

being.sentenceEn: To find out if this extends to non-living beings , Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.
being.translationZh: 为了弄清楚这种能力是否适用于非生命体，加州大学圣地亚哥分校的拉莱·奎因(Laleh Quinn)和她的同事们测试了老鼠能否探测到机器鼠发出的社交信号。
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

being.sentenceEn: But "it's us, human beings , we the people who create the society we want, not profit."
being.translationZh: 但她强调：'创造我们理想社会的是我们人类自己，是我们人民大众，而非利润。'
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

being.sentenceEn: It's a sad reality – our desire to avoid interacting with other human beings – because there's much to be gained from talking to the stranger standing by you.
being.translationZh: 这是一个令人悲哀的现实——我们渴望避免与他人互动——因为与身边的陌生人交谈其实能带来诸多收获。
being.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

blame.sentenceEn: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it "controlled" the data and DeepMind merely "processed" it.
blame.translationZh: 德纳姆女士选择将责任集中归咎于英国国家医疗服务体系信托机构，因为根据现行法律，该机构对数据拥有'控制权'，而DeepMind仅仅是进行'数据处理'。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

blame.sentenceEn: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
blame.translationZh: 当前这场争议的部分责任在于天文学家。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

blame.sentenceEn: Millennials "remember their father and mother both were laid off. They blame it on the manufacturing recession," says Birgit Klohs, chief executive of The Right Place, a business development agency for western Michigan.
blame.translationZh: 密歇根州西部商业发展机构“The Right Place”的首席执行官比尔吉特·克洛斯表示，千禧一代“记得他们的父母都曾失业。他们将此归咎于制造业衰退。”
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

blame.sentenceEn: To some extent the housing sector must shoulder the blame .
blame.translationZh: 在一定程度上，住房部门必须承担责任。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

blame.sentenceEn: When we are deprived of green, of plants, of trees, most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic.
blame.translationZh: 当我们被剥夺了绿色、植物和树木的环绕时，大多数人会陷入精神萎靡的状态，而我们通常将这种状态归咎于某些心理问题，直到有一天我们置身于某个花园中，才会感到那种压抑感奇迹般地消失了。
blame.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

blame.sentenceEn: Who Are to Blame for the Strikes?

burden.sentenceEn: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
burden.translationZh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

burden.sentenceEn: It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual: every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.
burden.translationZh: 这已经成了一个令人沮丧却又如期而至的年度惯例：每年一月，火车票价都会上涨，给那些别无选择、只能依靠铁路通勤上班或出行的人们带来沉重的额外负担。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

burden.sentenceEn: I'm experiencing increased zeal for working out since I no longer carry the burden of a disappointing morning weigh-in.
burden.translationZh: 我对锻炼的热情日益高涨，因为我再也不用背负早晨称重结果令人失望的负担了。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

burden.sentenceEn: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.
burden.translationZh: 后一项措施将在很大程度上抵消每年预先资助退休人员医疗保健的财务负担，从而解决美国邮政署及其工会长期以来的一项抱怨。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

burden.sentenceEn: To the men and women who served in World War II and the people they liberated, the G.I. was the common man grown into hero, the poor farm kid torn away from his home, the guy who bore all the burdens of battle, who slept in cold foxholes, who went without the necessities of food and shelter, who stuck it out and drove back the Nazi reign of murder.
burden.translationZh: 对于那些曾在二战中服役的男女士兵以及他们解放的民众而言，G.I.是平凡人成长起来的英雄，是被迫背井离乡的贫苦农家子弟，是肩负战争重负、蜷缩在冰冷散兵坑、缺衣少食却依然坚守阵地、击退纳粹杀戮统治的战士。
burden.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

burden.sentenceEn: They put too much burden on individual motorists.
burden.translationZh: 它们将过多负担加在了个体驾车者身上。

bias.sentenceEn: Reading has also been found to make us more helpful, to reduce bias , and even to increase longevity — something we will enjoy all the more if we have a good book in our hands.
bias.translationZh: 研究还发现，阅读能让我们更乐于助人，减少偏见，甚至延长寿命——如果我们手里有一本好书，我们将更加享受这份长寿带来的乐趣。

bias.sentenceEn: It uses analytics to help identify where there may be bias in the hiring process.
bias.translationZh: 该公司利用分析技术帮助识别招聘过程中可能存在偏见的环节。
bias.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

bias.sentenceEn: Companies are using artificial intelligence to remove some of the unconscious bias from hiring decisions.
bias.translationZh: 企业正利用人工智能来消除招聘决策中的一些无意识偏见。
bias.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

bias.sentenceEn: They cross-check sources and prefer news from different perspectives – especially those that are open about any bias .
bias.translationZh: 他们会交叉核对信息来源，更倾向于获取不同视角的新闻——尤其是那些对自身偏见持开放态度的新闻来源。
bias.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

bias.sentenceEn: Teachers, employers, and health professionals have been shown to harbor biases against the obese.
bias.translationZh: 事实表明，教师、雇主和医疗专业人员也对肥胖者抱有偏见。
bias.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

bias.sentenceEn: Putting things alphabetically may lead to unintentional bias .
bias.translationZh: 按字母顺序排列事物可能会导致无意识的偏见。
bias.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

battle.sentenceEn: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.
battle.translationZh: 战争日益依赖于雷达和近炸引信等新型军事技术。
battle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

battle.sentenceEn: I first discovered the Napoleonic cryptographic battle a few years ago when I was reading Sir Charles Oman's epic History of the Peninsular War.
battle.translationZh: 几年前，我在阅读查尔斯·奥曼爵士的鸿篇巨著《半岛战争史》时，首次发现了拿破仑战争时期这场密码战的存在。
battle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

battle.sentenceEn: It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period, a battle between those who made codes and those who broke them.
battle.translationZh: 然而鲜为人知的是——即便是对那个时期有深入了解的人也未必知晓——这场战争同时也是一场密码编制者与密码破解者之间的较量。
battle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

battle.sentenceEn: The endless legal battles and back-and-forth at the FCC cry out for Congress to act.
battle.translationZh: 无休止的法律纠纷以及联邦通信委员会内部的反复拉锯，迫切需要国会采取行动。
battle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

battle.sentenceEn: That means more battles like the one now going on between the Justice Department and California, which enacted a tough net neutrality law in the wake of the FCC's abdication.
battle.translationZh: 这意味着将会有更多类似目前司法部与加利福尼亚州之间正在进行的斗争，后者在联邦通信委员会放弃监管后颁布了一项严格的网络中立性法律。
battle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

battle.sentenceEn: The Church's long-standing dogma was losing the great battle for truth to rationalists and scientists.
battle.translationZh: 教会长期以来的教条在这场追求真理的伟大斗争中逐渐败给了理性主义者和科学家。
battle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

biased.sentenceEn: "There are experiments that show that, naturally, the results of interviews are much more biased than what AI does," says Pedro Domingos, author of The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World and a computer science professor at the University of Washington.
biased.translationZh: 华盛顿大学计算机科学教授、《终极算法：机器学习如何重塑我们的世界》一书作者佩德罗·多明戈斯（Pedro Domingos）表示：“实验表明，面试结果自然而然地比人工智能的判断带有更多偏见。”
biased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

biased.sentenceEn: This is not a free market but a biased one.
biased.translationZh: 这并非自由市场，而是带有偏见的市场。
biased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

biased.sentenceEn: But Dr Uri Simonsohn speculated that an inability to consider the big picture was leading decision-makers to be biased by the daily samples of information they were working with.
biased.translationZh: 但尤里·西蒙松博士推测，这种无法考虑全局的能力缺陷会导致决策者受到他们日常接触的信息样本的影响而产生偏见。
biased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

biased.sentenceEn: Outside directors are supposed to serve as helpful, yet less biased , advisers on a firm's board.
biased.translationZh: 外部董事应当在公司董事会中充当有益且相对公正的顾问角色。
biased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

biased.sentenceEn: They are biased against car manufacturers.
biased.translationZh: 它们对汽车制造商存在偏见。

boom.sentenceEn: Some will say the audiobook boom revives it, though I suppose you can then worry about the decline of reading.
boom.translationZh: 有人会说有声书的兴起让它得以复兴，不过我想接下来你可能又要担心阅读能力的下降了。
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

boom.sentenceEn: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
boom.translationZh: 然而，如果认为我们当前只是在经历经济繁荣与萧条周期中的阵痛，那就错了。
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

boom.sentenceEn: He'd been through the dot-com boom and burst and, desperate for a job, signed on with a Boulder agency.
boom.translationZh: 他经历了互联网泡沫的繁荣与破裂，急于找到工作，于是与博尔德一家代理商签约。
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

boom.sentenceEn: Many consumers seem to have been influenced by stock-market swings, which investors now view as a necessary ingredient to a sustained boom .
boom.translationZh: 许多消费者似乎受到了股市波动的影响，而投资者现在将这种波动视为经济持续繁荣的必要因素。
boom.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

boom.sentenceEn: A boom in neighborhood surveillance cameras will, for example, cause problems in 2010, while the arrival of synthetic lifelike robots will mean people may not be able to distinguish between their human friends and the droids.
boom.translationZh: 例如，社区监控摄像头的激增将在2010年引发问题，而逼真的人造机器人的出现将意味着人们可能无法区分人类朋友和机器人。
boom.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
boom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

boom.sentenceEn: Such a slowdown usually precedes a boom .
boom.translationZh: 这样的放缓通常是繁荣的前兆。
boom.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

branch.sentenceEn: As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald's.
branch.translationZh: 当我走访全国各地的图书馆时，令我惊讶的是，图书馆的数量（2,892家）竟然是麦当劳门店数量的两倍还多。
branch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

branch.sentenceEn: Glenn Branch , the centre's deputy director, cautions that setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards.
branch.translationZh: 该中心副主任格伦·布兰奇提醒说，在一个将决策权下放给地方学区委员会的国家，制定州级科学标准只是一个有限的基准。
branch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

branch.sentenceEn: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were "quietly retiring them to their relevant sections".
branch.translationZh: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，水石书店各分店经理接到指示，要求将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍从展台、陈列区和橱窗等显眼位置移走，并将其“悄然归位到相应的分类区域”。
branch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

branch.sentenceEn: If you're heading for your nearest branch of Waterstones, the biggest book retailer in the UK, in search of the Duchess of Sussex's new children's book The Bench, you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit; the same may be true of The President's Daughter, the new thriller by Bill Clinton and James Patterson.
branch.translationZh: 如果你正前往英国最大的图书零售商水石书店(Waterstones)的最近分店，寻找苏塞克斯公爵夫人的新儿童读物《长凳》(The Bench)，你可能需要做好到处搜寻的准备；比尔·克林顿与詹姆斯·帕特森合著的新惊悚小说《总统的女儿》(The President's Daughter)可能也是如此。
branch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

branch.sentenceEn: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
branch.translationZh: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了气候变化方面的科学共识，但一些传达更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料仍在向教师们传播。
branch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

branch.sentenceEn: Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue.
branch.translationZh: 水石书店各分店收入大幅减少。

budget.sentenceEn: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets , that it's easy to fall victim.
budget.translationZh: 市面上有如此多的产品在巨额广告和营销预算的推波助澜下进行促销，以至于人们很容易成为受害者。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

budget.sentenceEn: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires – nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
budget.translationZh: 2015年，美国林务局首次将其55亿美元年度预算的一半以上用于火灾扑救——这一比例几乎是20年前的两倍。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

budget.sentenceEn: Those things might be social, sporting, creative or completely random (dancing around the living room, anyone?) – it doesn't matter, so long as they're enjoyable, and not likely to have negative side effects, such as drinking too much alcohol or going on a wild spending spree if you're on a tight budget .
budget.translationZh: 这些活动可以是社交聚会、体育运动、创意创作，或者完全随性的事情（比如在客厅里跳跳舞，有人想试试吗？）—— 具体是什么并不重要，只要能带来乐趣，并且不会产生负面影响就行，比如过量饮酒，或者在预算紧张时疯狂购物。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

budget.sentenceEn: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted – the trouble is, no one knows which half.
budget.translationZh: 有句老话说得好：广告费有一半都打了水漂——问题是，没人知道是哪一半。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

budget.sentenceEn: He's feeling positive, but he'll carry on blogging – not about eating as cheaply as you can – "there are so many people in a much worse state, with barely any money to spend on food" – but eating well on a budget .
budget.translationZh: 他现在心态积极，但会继续写博客——不是教大家如何尽可能吃得便宜，"毕竟还有很多人处境艰难，几乎没钱买食物"——而是如何在预算之内吃得营养美味。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

budget.sentenceEn: Mark Baldassare of the Public Policy Institute of California points out that much of the state's budget is patrolled by unions.
budget.translationZh: 加州公共政策研究所的马克·巴尔达萨雷指出，该州的大部分预算都处于工会的监督之下。
budget.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

broadband.sentenceEn: That's why there has been such a strong demand for rules that would prevent broadband providers from picking winners and losers online, preserving the freedom and innovation that have been the lifeblood of the Internet.
broadband.translationZh: 这正是人们强烈要求制定相关规则的原因——这些规则将阻止宽带服务商在网络上偏袒某些企业、打压另一些企业，从而维护作为互联网生命线的自由与创新精神。
broadband.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

broadband.sentenceEn: The Republican-penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission's authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything.
broadband.translationZh: 这份由共和党人起草的命令不仅废除了FCC在2015年民主党占多数时通过的严格网络中立规则，还否定了该委员会对宽带提供商实施诸多监管的权力。
broadband.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

broadband.sentenceEn: Yet that demand has been almost impossible to fill—in part because of pushback from broadband providers, anti-regulatory conservatives and the courts.
broadband.translationZh: 然而，这一诉求几乎不可能实现——部分原因是来自宽带提供商、反监管的保守派以及法院的抵制。
broadband.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

broadband.sentenceEn: It needs to give the commission explicit authority once and for all to bar broadband providers from meddling in the traffic on their network and to create clear rules protecting openness and innovation online.
broadband.translationZh: 国会需要一劳永逸地赋予联邦通信委员会明确的权力，以禁止宽带供应商干预其网络上的流量，并制定明确的规则来保护网络的开放性和创新性。
broadband.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

broadband.sentenceEn: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.
broadband.translationZh: 然而，联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带服务商的调查，这些服务商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置了数据上限，却对自家服务网开一面。
broadband.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

broadband.sentenceEn: Broadband providers' rights should be protected.
broadband.translationZh: 宽带服务商的权利应得到保护。

beginning.sentenceEn: It was only after I started to write a weekly column about the medical journals, and began to read scientific papers from beginning to end, that I realised just how bad much of the medical literature frequently was.
beginning.translationZh: 直到我开始撰写一个关于医学期刊的每周专栏，并开始从头到尾阅读科学论文时，我才意识到大量医学文献的质量常常有多糟糕。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

beginning.sentenceEn: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
beginning.translationZh: 我们仍处于这场革命的开端，当下的微小选择未来可能会产生巨大的影响。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

beginning.sentenceEn: The development of the Elizabethan drama for the next twenty-five years is of exceptional interest to students of literary history, for in this brief period we may trace the beginning , growth, blossoming, and decay of many kinds of plays, and of many great careers.
beginning.translationZh: 伊丽莎白时期戏剧在接下来二十五年的发展，对于文学史研究者而言具有非凡的意义，因为在这短暂的时期内，我们可以追溯到多种戏剧类型以及众多伟大职业生涯的开端、成长、繁荣与衰落。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

beginning.sentenceEn: Since the beginning , this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw.
beginning.translationZh: 从一开始，这一价格标签就成了预检计划的致命缺陷。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

beginning.sentenceEn: This has created "a paradox" in that recruiting first-generation students, but then watching many of them fail, means that higher education has "continued to reproduce and widen, rather than close" an achievement gap based on social class, according to the depressing beginning of a paper forthcoming in the journal Psychological Science.
beginning.translationZh: 《心理科学》期刊即将发表的一篇论文在开头便揭示了这一令人沮丧的现象：这种做法形成了一个"悖论"——招收第一代大学生，却眼睁睁看着他们中的许多人学业失败，这意味着高等教育"非但没有缩小基于社会阶层的成就差距，反而在持续复制并扩大它"。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

beginning.sentenceEn: Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings .
beginning.translationZh: 在社会科学领域，达尔文主义似乎提供了一种合理化解释：如果所有人类拥有共同的起源，那么认为文化多样性也可能追溯到更为有限的源头似乎是合理的。
beginning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

behavioral.sentenceEn: In a series of four experiments, behavioral scientists at the University of Chicago and the Wisconsin School of Business tested students' willingness to expose themselves to unpleasant stimuli in an effort to satisfy curiosity.
behavioral.translationZh: 在一系列四项实验中，芝加哥大学和威斯康星商学院的行为科学家测试了学生为满足好奇心而愿意让自己接触不愉快刺激的程度。
behavioral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

behavioral.sentenceEn: In one 2011 experiment, behavioral scientists Nicholas Epley and Juliana Schroeder asked commuters to do the unthinkable: Start a conversation.
behavioral.translationZh: 在2011年的一项实验中，行为科学家尼古拉斯·埃普利和朱莉安娜·施罗德让通勤者做了一件难以想象的事情：主动发起交谈。
behavioral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

behavioral.sentenceEn: These two academics use an array of behavioral research to show that the most rewarding ways to spend money can be counterintuitive.
behavioral.translationZh: 这两位学者通过一系列行为研究表明，最能带来满足感的消费方式往往与我们的直觉相反。
behavioral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

behavioral.sentenceEn: The behavioral sciences have been slow to change partly because the explanatory items often seem to be directly observed and partly because other kinds of explanations have been hard to find.
behavioral.translationZh: 行为科学的变革之所以缓慢，部分原因在于这些解释性概念往往看似可以直接观察到，另一部分原因则是其他类型的解释一直难以找到。
behavioral.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
behavioral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

behavioral.sentenceEn: One difficulty is that almost all of what is called behavioral science continues to trace behavior to states of mind, feelings, traits of character, human nature, and so on.
behavioral.translationZh: 困难之一在于，几乎所有所谓的行为科学仍然将行为归因于心理状态、情感、性格特征、人性等等。
behavioral.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
behavioral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

behavioral.sentenceEn: These issues all have root causes in human behavior: all require behavioral change and social innovations, as well as technological development. Stemming climate change, for example, is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
behavioral.translationZh: 这些问题的根源都在于人类行为：所有问题的解决不仅需要技术发展，还需要行为改变和社会创新。例如，遏制气候变化既要发展清洁能源，也要改变消费模式和提高税收接受度。

biological.sentenceEn: Looking at these DNA sequences, we get a biological testimony to the environment these animals lived in and the experiences they survived.
biological.translationZh: 通过观察这些 DNA 序列，我们可以看到这些动物所处环境及其生存经历在生物学上留下的印记。
biological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

biological.sentenceEn: The zoology program at my university attracts students for whom zoo visits were the crucial formative experience that led them to major in biological sciences.
biological.translationZh: 我校动物学专业吸引的学生中，很多人正是因为参观动物园的宝贵经历，才决定主修生物科学。
biological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

biological.sentenceEn: Join the Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful.
biological.translationZh: 《加入俱乐部》一书充斥着过多无关细节，却未能充分探讨那些使同辈压力产生巨大影响的社会和生物因素。
biological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

biological.sentenceEn: Coinciding with the groundbreaking theory of biological evolution proposed by British naturalist Charles Darwin in the 1860s, British social philosopher Herbert Spencer put forward his own theory of biological and cultural evolution.
biological.translationZh: 19世纪60年代，英国博物学家查尔斯·达尔文提出了具有开创性的生物进化论，与此同时，英国社会哲学家赫伯特·斯宾塞也提出了自己的生物和文化进化理论。
biological.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
biological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

biological.sentenceEn: Their methods do not attempt to estimate the actual biomass (the amount of living biological matter) of fish species in particular parts of the ocean, but rather changes in that biomass over time.
biological.translationZh: 他们的方法并非试图估算特定海域鱼类的实际生物量（活体生物的总量），而是研究该生物量随时间的变化。
biological.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
biological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

biological.sentenceEn: Biological factors behind eye contact are being investigated
biological.translationZh: 眼神交流背后的生物学因素正在研究中

brand.sentenceEn: By allowing AI to develop content some brand marketers may find that they are losing control over the brand narrative.
brand.translationZh: 如果允许人工智能生成内容，一些品牌营销人员可能会发现他们正在失去对品牌叙事的控制。
brand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

brand.sentenceEn: Offering up such a theory during a time of high tension between scientific and religious minds was branded as heresy and any such heretics that continued to spread these lies were to be punished by imprisonment or even death.
brand.translationZh: 在科学思想与宗教思想关系高度紧张的时期提出这样的理论，被视为异端邪说，而任何继续传播这些'谎言'的异端分子都将面临监禁甚至死刑的惩罚。
brand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

brand.sentenceEn: "Millennials wanted more flexibility in their lives," notes Tanya Michelsen, Associate Director of YouthSight, a UK-based brand manager that conducts regular 60-day surveys of British youth, in findings that might just as well apply to American youth.
brand.translationZh: 英国品牌管理公司YouthSight的副总监Tanya Michelsen指出：'千禧一代希望生活有更大的灵活性。'该公司定期对英国年轻人进行为期60天的调查，其研究结果同样适用于美国年轻人。
brand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

brand.sentenceEn: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
brand.translationZh: 间隔年的经历能够减轻适应大学生活以及突然进入全新环境时的冲击，使学生更容易专注于学业和各类活动，而非适应过程中的种种失误。
brand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

brand.sentenceEn: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.
brand.translationZh: 克莱因认为，这些品牌通过以极低价格提供时尚单品，已经劫持了时尚周期，撼动了这个长期习惯于季节性节奏的行业。
brand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

brand.sentenceEn: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
brand.translationZh: 我们要么将他们誉为正在成长的美国人，要么将他们贴上“应驱逐出境的外国人”的标签。
brand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

barely.sentenceEn: A study last year by the National Center for Science Education, a non-profit group of scientists and teachers, looking at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes, gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher.
barely.translationZh: 美国国家科学教育中心（一个由科学家和教师组成的非营利组织）去年开展了一项研究，调查全美各州公立学校在科学课程中如何涉及气候变化议题。结果显示，美国仅有不到一半的州获得了B+或更高等级。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

barely.sentenceEn: In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart.
barely.translationZh: 短短十多年间，有机鸡蛋就从天然食品店中无人问津的小众产品，摇身一变进入了沃尔玛的货架。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

barely.sentenceEn: During their six- to twelve-week voyage, they survived on barely enough food allotted to them.
barely.translationZh: 在六到十二周的航程中，他们仅靠配给的勉强够量的食物维持生命。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

barely.sentenceEn: Another urge or need that these gardens appear to respond to, or to arise from, is so intrinsic that we are barely ever conscious of its abiding claims on us.
barely.translationZh: 这些花园似乎还回应或源于另一种需求，这种需求根深蒂固，我们几乎从未意识到它对我们持久的诉求。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

barely.sentenceEn: He's feeling positive, but he'll carry on blogging – not about eating as cheaply as you can – "there are so many people in a much worse state, with barely any money to spend on food" – but eating well on a budget.
barely.translationZh: 他现在心态积极，但会继续写博客——不是教大家如何尽可能吃得便宜，"毕竟还有很多人处境艰难，几乎没钱买食物"——而是如何在预算之内吃得营养美味。
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

barely.sentenceEn: Making friends is extremely important to teenagers, and many shy students need the security of some kind of organization with a supportive adult barely visible in the background.
barely.translationZh: 结交朋友对青少年来说极为重要，许多腼腆的学生需要某种组织所提供的安全感，在这类组织中，有提供支持的成年人隐于幕后，几乎不被察觉。
barely.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
barely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

bay.sentenceEn: His pictures of a Glanville fritillary rising from the sea-pinks beside the chalk cliffs of Compton Bay on the Isle of Wight are particularly glorious.
bay.translationZh: 他拍摄的格兰维尔豹纹蝶从怀特岛康普顿湾白垩悬崖旁的海石竹中振翅而起的照片尤为壮丽。

bay.sentenceEn: But that's a very shortsighted view, particularly when it comes to the Chesapeake Bay .
bay.translationZh: 但这种观点非常短视，尤其是对于切萨皮克湾而言。
bay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

bay.sentenceEn: And it's a reminder that the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program has long been crucial as the means to transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests in neighboring states.
bay.translationZh: 这也提醒我们，长期以来，美国环保署参与切萨皮克湾项目至关重要，因为它是超越邻州财力雄厚的特殊利益集团影响的重要手段。
bay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

bay.sentenceEn: The miracle of the Chesapeake Bay lies not in its depths, but in the complexity of its natural construction, the interaction of fresh and saline waters, and the mix of land and water.
bay.translationZh: 切萨皮克湾的奇迹不在于其深度，而在于其复杂的自然构造、淡水与咸水的交汇融合，以及陆地与水域的相互交织。
bay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

bay.sentenceEn: The early settlers of Massachusetts Bay included men of impressive education and influence in England.
bay.translationZh: 马萨诸塞湾的早期定居者中，不乏在英格兰受过良好教育且颇具影响力的人士。
bay.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
bay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

bay.sentenceEn: How does the author feel about the future of the Chesapeake Bay ?
bay.translationZh: 作者对切萨皮克湾的未来持何种看法？

biologist.sentenceEn: "Donkeys are champions when it comes to carrying stuff and are good at crossing deserts," co-author Ludovic Orlando, an evolutionary biologist at Paul Sabatier University in France, tells the publication.
biologist.translationZh: 该研究的共同作者、法国保罗·萨巴蒂尔大学的进化生物学家卢多维克·奥兰多告诉该刊物：“驴在负重方面是冠军，而且非常擅长穿越沙漠。”
biologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

biologist.sentenceEn: "When you talk about conservation or restoration, the first question has to be restoration by whom, for whom?" says Daniel Janzen, a biologist at the University of Pennsylvania.
biologist.translationZh: “当你谈论保护或修复时，第一个问题必须是：由谁来修复，为了谁修复？”宾夕法尼亚大学的生物学家丹尼尔·詹森（Daniel Janzen）说道。
biologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

biologist.sentenceEn: Biologists estimate that as many as 2 million lesser prairie chickens – a kind of bird living on stretching grasslands – once lent red to the often grey landscape of the midwestern and southwestern United States.
biologist.translationZh: 生物学家估计，曾有多达200万只小草原榛鸡——一种生活在广袤草原上的鸟类——为美国中西部和西南部常显灰暗的 landscape 增添了一抹红色。
biologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

biologist.sentenceEn: "The federal government is giving responsibility for managing the bird to the same industries that are pushing it to extinction," says biologist Jay Lininger.
biologist.translationZh: 生物学家杰伊·林宁格表示：“联邦政府正将这种鸟类的管理权交给那些正将其推向灭绝边缘的行业。”
biologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

biologist.sentenceEn: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist .
biologist.translationZh: 细胞生物学家大卫·沃克斯表示，专业科学家理应懂得如何分析数据，但已发表的研究中统计错误却多得出奇。
biologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

biologist.sentenceEn: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species.
biologist.translationZh: 曾几何时，生物学家们也有些过度宣扬这样的证据：这些生物通过捕食体弱的个体来维持猎物群体的健康，或者它们只捕食那些“毫无价值”的物种。
biologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

buyer.sentenceEn: "Whilst admirable in their intentions, they will add to the cost of housebuilding at a time when many already feel that they are priced out of homeownership," says Jonathan Rolande of the National Association of Property Buyers .
buyer.translationZh: 全国购房者协会的乔纳森·罗兰德表示：“尽管这些新规的初衷值得赞赏，但它们将进一步增加房屋建设成本，而眼下已有许多人感到自己被排除在购房市场之外。”
buyer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

buyer.sentenceEn: In other words, it is up to the buyer , rather than the seller, to decide what to buy.
buyer.translationZh: 换句话说，买什么要由买方而非卖方决定。

buyer.sentenceEn: America's new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive.
buyer.translationZh: 美国收购不良资产的新计划不会奏效，除非银行将资产定价在对买家有吸引力的水平上。
buyer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

buyer.sentenceEn: And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers , reviving the banking system will be difficult.
buyer.translationZh: 而且，除非银行以能够吸引买家的价格持有不良资产，否则银行体系的复苏将举步维艰。
buyer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

buyer.sentenceEn: The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers .
buyer.translationZh: 市场的运行基于由潜在买家主导的灵活趋势。

buyer.sentenceEn: Of course, the pharmaceutical companies will scream. They like divided buyers ; they can lobby better that way. They can use the threat of removing jobs from one province to another. They can hope that, if one province includes a drug on its list, the pressure will cause others to include it on theirs. They wouldn't like a national agency, but self-interest would lead them to deal with it.
buyer.translationZh: 当然，制药公司会强烈反对。他们喜欢分散的买家；这样他们可以更好地进行游说。他们可以威胁将工作岗位从一个省转移到另一个省。他们可以期望，如果一个省将某种药物列入其清单，这种压力会迫使其他省份也将其列入各自的清单。他们不会喜欢全国性机构，但自身利益会促使他们与该机构打交道。
buyer.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

banker.sentenceEn: The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions.
banker.translationZh: 这项“追回”规则的主要目的是让银行家对有害的冒险行为负责，并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。
banker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

banker.sentenceEn: Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.
banker.translationZh: 英国的新规提醒银行家们，社会关注的是他们的业绩表现，不仅是短期的，更是长期的。
banker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

banker.sentenceEn: Bankers' fat pay packets have attracted much criticism, but a public-sector system that does not reward high achievers may be a much bigger problem for America.
banker.translationZh: 银行家们丰厚的薪酬待遇招致了诸多批评，但一个不奖励杰出人才的公共部门体系，对美国而言可能是一个严重得多的问题。
banker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

banker.sentenceEn: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public.
banker.translationZh: 银行家们在公开场合一直将他们的困境归咎于自身。
banker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

banker.sentenceEn: The world's three top central bankers (Greenspan, Duisenberg and Hayami) are all close to the top of the alphabet, even if one of them really uses Japanese characters.
banker.translationZh: 世界三大央行行长（格林斯潘、 Duisenberg 和速水优）的姓氏首字母都靠近字母表的开头，尽管其中一位实际上使用的是日文汉字。
banker.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
banker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

belong.sentenceEn: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
belong.translationZh: 关键问题在于，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发它们的私人垄断企业。
belong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

belong.sentenceEn: While fossil fuels – coal, oil, gas – still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
belong.translationZh: 虽然化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍占全球能源供应的约85%，但未来属于风能和太阳能等可再生能源这一点比以往任何时候都更加明确。
belong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

belong.sentenceEn: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
belong.translationZh: 当前这场争议的部分责任在于天文学家。
belong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

belong.sentenceEn: Some powers do belong exclusively to the federal government, and control of citizenship and the borders is among them.
belong.translationZh: 某些权力确实专属于联邦政府，其中包括公民身份和边境的控制权。
belong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

belong.sentenceEn: We need them to feel that home can be both here and there and that they can belong to two nations honorably.
belong.translationZh: 我们需要让他们感受到，家可以同时安在两地，他们也可以体面地属于两个国家。
belong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

belong.sentenceEn: Which of the following does NOT belong to products that help create people's habits?
belong.translationZh: 以下哪项不属于帮助养成人们习惯的产品？

biology.sentenceEn: There are around 40 official do-it-yourself biology centres across the globe in locations including Paris, London, Sydney, and Tel Aviv.
biology.translationZh: 全球约有40个官方的自助生物学中心，分布在巴黎、伦敦、悉尼和特拉维夫等城市。
biology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

biology.sentenceEn: The rise of citizen science has grown alongside the rise of do-it-yourself biology laboratories around the world.
biology.translationZh: 公民科学的兴起与全球范围内DIY生物实验室的增多相伴而行。
biology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

biology.sentenceEn: Another issue is that while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages—such as earth and space sciences in high schools—it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry.
biology.translationZh: 另一个问题是，虽然气候变化已很好地融入某些学科和特定年龄段的教学中——例如高中的地球与空间科学——但在低龄儿童的课程以及生物、化学等开设更为普遍的学科中，气候变化的内容却未能得到同等程度的体现。
biology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

biology.sentenceEn: Plant biology is complex and fascinating, but it differs so greatly from that of animals that so-called evidence of plants' intelligence is inconclusive, the authors wrote.
biology.translationZh: 作者写道，植物生物学复杂而迷人，但其与动物生物学存在巨大差异，因此所谓植物拥有智能的证据并不确凿。
biology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

biology.sentenceEn: Scientists must communicate their message to the public in a compassionate, understandable way—in human terms, not in the language of molecular biology .
biology.translationZh: 科学家必须以富有同情心且易于理解的方式向公众传达信息——要用通俗易懂的语言，而非分子生物学的专业术语。
biology.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
biology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

biology.sentenceEn: In order to study particular cultures as completely as possible, he became skilled in linguistics, the study of languages, and in physical anthropology, the study of human biology and anatomy.
biology.translationZh: 为了尽可能全面地研究特定文化，博厄斯精通了语言学（即对语言的研究）和体质人类学（即对人类生物学与解剖学的研究）。
biology.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

brief.sentenceEn: Neuroscientist Bonnie Auyeung found that the hormone oxytocin increased the amount of eye contact from men toward the interviewer during a brief interview when the direction of their gaze was recorded.
brief.translationZh: 神经科学家邦妮·欧阳（Bonnie Auyeung）发现，在短暂的面试中记录男性的注视方向时，荷尔蒙催产素会增加他们与面试官的眼神交流次数。
brief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

brief.sentenceEn: The development of the Elizabethan drama for the next twenty-five years is of exceptional interest to students of literary history, for in this brief period we may trace the beginning, growth, blossoming, and decay of many kinds of plays, and of many great careers.
brief.translationZh: 伊丽莎白时期戏剧在接下来二十五年的发展，对于文学史研究者而言具有非凡的意义，因为在这短暂的时期内，我们可以追溯到多种戏剧类型以及众多伟大职业生涯的开端、成长、繁荣与衰落。
brief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

brief.sentenceEn: In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule "is no less a product of nature…than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds."
brief.translationZh: 10月，美国司法部就Myriad案提交了一份案情摘要，主张分离出的DNA分子“如同从棉籽中分离出的棉纤维一样，依然是自然的产物……”
brief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

brief.sentenceEn: Straitford's briefs don't sound like the usual Washington back-and-forthing, whereby agencies avoid dramatic declarations on the chance they might be wrong.
brief.translationZh: 斯特雷福德公司的情报简报听起来不像华盛顿通常的那样言辞闪烁，政府机构因担心出错而避免做出明确声明。
brief.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
brief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

brief.sentenceEn: This, in brief , is what the Futurist says: for a century, past conditions of life have been conditionally speeding up, till now we live in a world of noise and violence and speed.
brief.translationZh: 简而言之，未来主义者的主张是这样的：一个世纪以来，过去的生活状况一直在有条件地加速变化，直至今日我们生活在一个充满喧嚣、暴力与速度的世界。
brief.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
brief.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

brief.translationZh: 眼睛注视的时间很短暂

broadly.sentenceEn: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish."
broadly.translationZh: 当被问及是否有特定论文推动了这一变革时，麦克纳特表示：“‘统计委员会’的成立是受到对科学研究中统计和数据分析应用的普遍担忧所驱动，同时也是《科学》杂志提高其所发表研究可重复性的整体努力的一部分。”
broadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

broadly.sentenceEn: It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage.
broadly.translationZh: 直到"学步儿童"成为购物者的常用术语后，它才演变为一个被广泛接受的发育阶段。
broadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

broadly.sentenceEn: Politics or, more broadly , the functioning of the state, is a major subject for journalists.
broadly.translationZh: 政治，或者更广泛地说，国家的运作方式，是记者报道的主要题材。
broadly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
broadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

broadly.sentenceEn: The Economist's commodity price index is broadly unchanging from a year ago.
broadly.translationZh: 《经济学人》的大宗商品价格指数与一年前相比基本没有变化。
broadly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
broadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

broadly.sentenceEn: If it did, it would open up its diversity program, now focused narrowly on race and gender, and look for reporters who differ broadly by outlook, values, education, and class.
broadly.translationZh: 如果新闻业真能做到这一点，它就会拓展其多元化项目——目前该项目仅狭隘地关注种族和性别问题——并招聘那些在世界观、价值观、教育背景和社会阶层方面存在显著差异的记者。
broadly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
broadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

broadly.sentenceEn: Gambling has been a common feature of American life forever, but for a long time it was broadly considered a sin, or a social disease. Now it is a social policy: the most important and aggressive promoter of gambling in America is the government.
broadly.translationZh: 赌博一直是美国生活的常见特征，但长期以来它被普遍视为一种罪恶或社会弊病。如今，它却成了一项社会政策：在美国，赌博最重要且最积极的推动者就是政府。
broadly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
